english: The sea between PACIFIDLOG and\nSLATEPORT has a fast-running tide.\pIf you decide to SURF, you could end\nup swept away somewhere else.
dutch: De zee tussen PACIFIDLOG en\nSLATEPORT heeft een sterke stroming.\pAls je SURFEN gebruikt, word je\nmisschien ergens anders heen gespoeld.

english: See, isn't it neat?\nThese houses are on water!\pI was born here!
dutch: Gaaf, hè?\nDeze huizen staan op water!\pIk ben hier geboren!

english:
The SKY PILLAR?\p…Oh, you must mean that tall, tall
tower a little further out.\pIf you asked me, I wouldn't climb it.
It's too scary to get up that high.\pLife at sea level in PACIFIDLOG,
that suits me fine.
dutch:
De SKY PILLAR?\p…Oh, je bedoelt die hele hoge
toren wat verderop.\pIk zou er niet op klimmen.
Het is te eng om zo hoog te gaan.\pHet leven op zeeniveau in PACIFIDLOG
bevalt me prima.

english: PACIFIDLOG TOWN\p“Where the morning sun smiles upon\nthe waters.”
dutch: PACIFIDLOG TOWN\p“Waar de ochtendzon lacht naar\nhet water.”
